subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add escapeHtml seam and collapse six copies

question: Should this PR be rebuilt as a narrow HTML-escaping change, or should the current mixed-purpose branch remain the vehicle for all accumulated changes?
rationale: The branch is protected, conflicted, and combines several independent compatibility-sensitive decisions, so automation cannot safely choose whether to preserve or discard the unrelated work.

options.title: Rebuild the narrow PR
options.body: Retain only the shared HTML helper, six caller migrations, focused tests, API baseline, and SDK documentation on current main.

options.title: Keep the combined branch
options.body: Resolve the conflicts and review every unrelated configuration, provider, delivery, dependency, and UI change as one coordinated release-sized change.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close this branch while keeping the linked issue open, then submit a fresh narrow PR for the useful helper consolidation.

recommendation.title: Rebuild the narrow PR
recommendation.body: Retain only the shared HTML helper, six caller migrations, focused tests, API baseline, and SDK documentation on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue, assignment, protected label, and trusted-administrator context make this person the clearest available owner for deciding the branch shape.
